name: MSA Type 4 (linearity)
description: Measurement System Analysis Type 4 — linearity and bias across the measurement range (AIAG %Lin, VDA 5 Q_MS,BI)
whenToUse: When you need to check whether a measurement system measures equally correctly across the whole range: reference values and measured values as columns give the bias per reference point and a regression of the bias over the range (AIAG %linearity or VDA 5 Q_MS,BI) — not for capability on a single standard, which type 1 covers. Requires a reference column and a measured column of a data collection.
emptyState: Select reference and measured columns to start the analysis.
errLengthMismatch: Reference and measured columns must have the same length.
errTooFewReferences: At least 5 distinct reference values required (currently {got}).
errInvalidPv: Invalid process variation basis. Tolerance must be > 0, or σₚ > 0.
interpAIAG_green: No significant slope (p={pSlope}) and no significant bias. %Linearity {pctLin} %, max. %Bias {maxPctBias} % — measurement system is linear and unbiased across the measurement range.
interpAIAG_yellow: %Linearity {pctLin} % or max. %Bias {maxPctBias} % in the gray zone (5–10 %). Investigate cause (calibration, gage).
interpAIAG_red: %Linearity {pctLin} % or max. %Bias {maxPctBias} % > 10 %, or slope/intercept significant. Measurement system not suitable for this tolerance range — calibrate or replace.
interpVDA5_green: Q_MS,BI = {qMsBi} % ≤ 15 %. Bias/linearity contribution to measurement uncertainty unremarkable.
interpVDA5_yellow: Q_MS,BI = {qMsBi} % in the range 15–30 %. Conditionally suitable, review the overall uncertainty budget.
interpVDA5_red: Q_MS,BI = {qMsBi} % > 30 %. Not suitable — rework the measurement system.

invariants.limitsOrder: The lower spec limit (LSL) must be less than the upper (USL)
